guitar.notes: Indie-folk band, acoustic-driven sound; no documented signature instrument.

tone.target: jangly clean indie pop with chorusy shimmer
tone.profile: jangly clean indie pop with chorusy shimmer
tone.summary: A bright, clean signal chain utilizing a Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) with Chorus and Room reverb to achieve the jangly, shimmering indie pop sound.

rig.name: Of Monsters And Men - Little Talks - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Slightly lift the signal and add initial brightness for jangle.
blocks.gap: The Boost module is used as a gentle tone shaper rather than a traditional boost pedal, fitting the clean indie aesthetic.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone pristine and clean; no drive needed.
Simulate the bright, clean Fender/Vox sound required for indie pop.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the best fit for the specified Vox/Fender clean tone and single-coil character.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright, focused cabinet sound matching the single-coil and 2x12 clue.
Create the required 'chorus shimmer' and modulation for the jangly sound.
Fine-tune the tone to emphasize brightness and cut low end muddiness.
blocks.gap: Used for surgical EQ adjustments, enhancing the 'bright jangle' quality.

blocks.purpose: Provide the required 'short reverb' and ambient shimmer without sounding excessive.
blocks.gap: Room reverb is chosen over Plate/Spring for a natural, open acoustic space feel suitable for indie pop.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the default IR for a more open, vintage-voiced option to better capture the Vox/Fender clean aesthetic.

proposals.reason: Enhance the natural, open sound of a vintage Fender/Vox setup.
